Messages.Author: BogusMagus
Messages.Body:
How long does "as the action is announced" window stay open?

(1) Can I use a card that was drawn to replace an action card in "as the action is announced" window?
My vampire plays "Govern the Unaligned (Inf)" to bleed.
Can I use "Seduction" that I had just drawn as a replacement for the "Govern the Unaligned" ?

(2) Can I use two (or more) cards in "as the action is announced" window?
My vampire plays "Govern the Unaligned (Inf)" to bleed.
Can I use both "Seduction" and "The Sleeping Mind" ?

***********************

Seduction
Action Modifier
Only usable as the acting vampire's action is announced.
[dom] Choose a younger vampire. That vampire cannot block this action.
[DOM] As above, but you may choose a vampire the same age or older.

Sleeping Mind, The
Action Modifier
[dom] Choose a tapped vampire. He or she cannot attempt to block this action.
[DOM] Minions cannot untap during this action.

***********************

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> BogusMagus wrote:
> How long does "as the action is announced" window stay open?
>
It starts after the action card is played (if any), not cancelled, and replaced. It then lasts until everyone passes - which a lot of the time, will be implicit because no-one leaps in to do anything.

> BogusMagus wrote:
> (1) Can I use a card that was drawn to replace an action card in "as the action is announced" window?
>
Yes.

> BogusMagus wrote:
> Can I use "Seduction" that I had just drawn as a replacement for the "Govern the Unaligned" ?
>
Yes.

> BogusMagus wrote:
> (2) Can I use two (or more) cards in "as the action is announced" window?
>
Yes. Just like you can play any number of cards in the "before range is determined" window, or whatever.

Messages.Author: BogusMagus
Messages.Body:

Thank you, jamesatzephyr.

Messages.Author: BogusMagus
Messages.Body:
One more question.

Can you play cards that does not have
"Only usable as the acting vampire's action is announced." clause
in the "as the action is announced" window?

For example, are the following legal?

A vampire plays "Govern the Unaligned (Inf)" to bleed.
Replaces. (Drew something irrelevant.)
Plays "Conditioning".
Replaces. (Drew "Seduction".)
Play "Seduction".
Replaces.
Pass the impulse.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
In particular, see this bit of the Detailed Play Summary:

IV. HOW TO PERFORM ACTIONS
..ADeclare the action. [6.2.1]
....1. Play the action card, if any, and define the action (target, cost, etc).
....2. Tap the acting minion.
....3. Cards that are played "as the action is announced" may be played (other effects cannot be played until after the "as announced" stuff is finished). [RTR]
